verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud has a dedicated pricing page on daily.co that lists agent profiles tied to compute needs, which points to published usage-based pricing. However, none of the quoted evidence shows actual per-minute rates or a way to estimate cost per call. missing for 10: actual per-minute/usage price figures, per-call cost estimation guidance or calculator, breakdown of third-party provider (STT/LLM/TTS/telephony) costs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing

citations.quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.
